entries.title: SteamWorld Tower Defense
entries.definitive_edition: SteamWorld Tower Defense on Nintendo DSi / DSiWare

emulation.notes: Use original hardware if already owned; otherwise this is a preservation case rather than a current storefront recommendation.

primary.why: The original DSiWare release is the only sourced platform release for SteamWorld Tower Defense, so it is the primary by necessity even though it is not a modern easy-access route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on a Nintendo DSi or 3DS family system that already has the DSiWare title installed, or use a preservation/emulation setup from a legally obtained copy for archive work.

all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: There is no modern PC/console remaster; completeness is tied to a legacy DSiWare route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or port is documented; access depends on legacy ownership or preservation.

entries.title: SteamWorld Heist
entries.definitive_edition: SteamWorld Heist: Ultimate Edition on Nintendo Switch

emulation.notes: Use Switch Ultimate Edition for the complete bundled route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Switch Ultimate Edition presentation with all DLC.

primary.why: The Nintendo Switch Ultimate Edition is the best currently recommendable complete route because it is optimized for Switch and bundled with all previously released DLC, including the mysterious new ally, weapons, upgrades, hats, and missions. The PC version is useful if already owned, but it is no longer sold, so Switch Ultimate is the clean complete-access primary.
primary.how_to_play: Buy SteamWorld Heist: Ultimate Edition on Nintendo Switch and play that version for the main run with The Outsider DLC included.

all_releases.fidelity: Ultimate Edition route with all previously released DLC included.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete and current-access route with The Outsider DLC bundled.

entries.title: SteamWorld Build
entries.definitive_edition: SteamWorld Build Deluxe/Gold Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with Mechanized DLC installed.

primary.why: The Windows PC Deluxe or Gold Edition route is the best archival version because those editions include the Mechanized DLC, which adds the Mech worker and related exploration/combat abilities, while PC keeps capture/settings flexibility. Console versions do not add exclusive gameplay content over PC.
